summary: Full backend + frontend test for VAPID Web Push, StreakReminder banner, Settings inline reset, and RESEND_API_KEY env fix. 14/14 backend pytest passed, all frontend flows passed. Push UI gracefully renders 'You've blocked notifications' fallback when permission denied (Playwright default). Service worker reachable and parses correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 745: db.push_subscriptions.update_one uses rec['_id'] returned from the find() cursor — fine, but the helper _send_push then deletes via {'_id': rec['_id']} when subscription is dead. Idempotent but if many subs are purged, consider batching delete_many.
push_send_streak_reminders has no test mode / dry-run flag — if VAPID is misconfigured the cron will silently purge real subscriptions. Consider adding a 'dry_run' query param.

server.py imports pywebpush at module level inside a section comment — module-level imports below the file-level docstring/imports is fine but conventional style is to hoist all imports. Low priority.
lib/push.js getPushStatus eagerly registers the service worker on every Settings page mount even when permission is denied — minor: could short-circuit when Notification.permission === 'denied'.

StreakReminder writes lastShown the moment the banner mounts, before user sees it — if React re-mounts (e.g. route prefetch) it would burn the 3-day window. In practice the page only mounts once per load so currently safe.
Settings.jsx still imports lucide-react icons in many places but the engagement section's Bell icon is fine. Files >300 lines could be split (Settings.jsx is 339 lines).
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed device_ids via /api/users/init for push subscribe/unsubscribe tests; localStorage cot.stats.v1 + cot.streak_reminder.v1 injected via page.evaluate for StreakReminder tests. No DB cleanup required (TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push UI cannot be tested for actual push delivery in headless Playwright (Notification.permission defaults to 'denied', no real FCM endpoint). Backend webpush integration is verified via the cron endpoint which returns sent/skipped/purged counts. To manually verify end-to-end: open the deployed URL in a real Chrome browser, allow notifications in Settings, then POST /api/push/test with x-cron-secret header equivalent device_id. Test data with TEST_ prefix is left in MongoDB push_subscriptions collection — cleanup not required but the cron will purge anything that fails on real send.

push_readiness_state.backend: READY. /api/push/vapid-public-key, /subscribe, /unsubscribe, /test, /send-streak-reminders all working. VAPID keys configured in backend/.env. CRON_SECRET set. pywebpush dependency installed.
push_readiness_state.frontend: READY. /sw.js reachable and exposes push + notificationclick listeners. /src/lib/push.js handles registration, permission, subscribe, unsubscribe, sendTest. Settings UI gracefully handles supported/unsupported/denied states with no placeholder checkbox.
push_readiness_state.what_works_in_test_env: All API endpoints, permission-denied fallback UI, service worker file served correctly, StreakReminder banner shows/hides/persists correctly, Settings inline Cancel/Wipe reset.
push_readiness_state.what_needs_real_device: User must (1) open the deployed app in real Chrome/Edge/Safari, (2) click Enable in Settings, (3) grant the browser permission prompt. Only then will a real push subscription be created with a live FCM/Mozilla endpoint.
push_readiness_state.production_env_vars_needed: All required env vars already present in backend/.env (VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY, VAPID_SUBJECT, CRON_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY). For production deploy ensure these are copied to the prod env. Recommend rotating VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY before public launch since it appears in repo .env.

verified_checks.Settings UI permission=denied: Shows 'You've blocked notifications' message, no enable/disable button, no placeholder checkbox
verified_checks.Settings reset-device: Inline Cancel/Wipe row shown (testids: reset-device-confirm-row, reset-device-cancel, reset-device-confirm). Cancel preserves device_id and hides row.
verified_checks.Home StreakReminder (no streak): Banner not rendered when all currentStreak=0
verified_checks.Home StreakReminder (streak=3, lastShown: Banner renders with CTA and close button; analytics streak_reminder_shown fires
verified_checks.Home StreakReminder dismiss: Click close hides banner, writes lastDismissed, survives reload within 3-day window

rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration verified a feature addition (Web Push) + a small bug fix (RESEND_APP_KEY → RESEND_API_KEY). Email health endpoint now correctly reports configured:true, push endpoints behave per spec including secret-protected cron, UI fallback states are user-friendly, and StreakReminder banner correctly enforces ≥3-day cadence with localStorage persistence.
